html:
News Digest:

Total assets under management (AuM) overseen by exchange-traded funds (ETFs) worldwide would top $20 trillion by 2026, expanding at a compound annual growth rate of 17% over the next five years, a newly released PwC study has forecast.

 

Takeaway:

According to the research, which is based on a poll of 60 executives representing over 80% of ETF assets, ETF AuM grew by 22% during the five years ended December 2020. A majority of respondents anticipate the bulk of product releases this year to be centred around environmental, social and governance (ESG) themes, PwC said.

 

 

End Notes
Source: https://www.wealthprofessional.ca/investments/etfs/pwc-projects-etf-assets-to-top-26-trillion-by-2026/366558
